items.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
items.description: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

items.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
items.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

items.title: Canada suspends plans to expand assisted dying to people with mental illness
items.description: People with mental illness alone were to be eligible for assisted dying in Canada in March 2027, but that has now been paused indefinitely.

items.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
items.description: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

items.title: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 24
items.description: Rescue workers are continuing a search for residents after an apartment building in Pryluky was destroyed.

items.title: Sri Lanka's ex-first lady arrested over alleged misuse of children's hospital donations
items.description: The 73-year-old has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations.

items.title: Chemistry Nobel awarded for solving mystery of life's asymmetry
items.description: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.
